subject: Approval request: Orbit spotlight clip + logo/quote usage
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Nina Patel <nina.patel@orbitcommerce.com>, Evan Long <evan.long@orbitcommerce.com>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 20 Nov 2026 14:03:00 -0800
Subject: Approval request: Orbit spotlight clip + logo/quote usage
Attachments: orbit_spotlight_clip_v1.mp4 (video/mp4), release_draft_orbit.docx (docx)

Hi Nina & Evan,

Really enjoyed the interview — thank you both. We cut a short 60- to 90-second spotlight clip that highlights the checkout improvements you achieved with Redwood and included a brief on-camera quote from Nina. We'd love to publish a trimmed version on our website and share a shorter cut on LinkedIn and X.

Ask: could Orbit approve the following by end of day Friday 27 Nov so we can schedule the publish for the week of Dec 6?
- Permission to publish the clip on redwood.com and on social channels.
- Permission to use Orbit Commerce name and a monochrome/stylized logo lockup as shown in our mock.
- Permission to use the quoted line from Nina (we can edit): "Redwood halved our checkout latency and stabilized inference costs."
- Sign the attached one-page release (we tried to keep it short).

If you want the metrics removed or rephrased, say the word and we will scrub numbers from both the audio transcript and any on-screen text. Rishi (cc) can handle the legal turnaround if needed.

Thanks again 30m excited about this one.

Warmly,
Tessa Morgan
Head of Customer Marketing
Redwood Inference

--
orbit_spotlight_clip_v1.mp4 attached (draft highlight, 90s).

From: Nina Patel <nina.patel@orbitcommerce.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Evan Long <evan.long@orbitcommerce.com>, Orbit Commerce Legal <legal@orbitcommerce.com>
Date: Sun, 22 Nov 2026 09:18:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Approval request: Orbit spotlight clip + logo/quote usage

Hi Tessa,

Thanks for the draft 30t looks strong. A few items from our side before we can sign off:
- Please remove exact throughput numbers from the voiceover and any onscreen stats; we prefer percent-based or qualitative language only.
- Use a monochrome/stylized logo instead of our full-color primary mark on public pages.
- Share the final transcript and a list of channels + publish window so our comms team can clear timing.
- Legal is cc'd and will review the release. They typically want a short turnaround but may propose a small edit to the scope clause.

We can aim to review within 48 hours after legal sees the final release. Thanks for keeping this concise.

Best,
Nina Patel
Director of Partnerships, Orbit Commerce

> On Fri, 20 Nov 2026 at 14:03, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com> wrote:
> > Hi Nina & Evan,
> > 
> > Really enjoyed the interview 30t was great to hear your team’s results...

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 24 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Orbit draft release + logo request

Laura / Rishi,

Looping you in 30 Nina asked us to redact specific throughput numbers and prefers the monochrome logo. I'm attaching the draft release we sent (release_draft_orbit.docx) and the transcript with numbers highlighted. Can you: 
1) Confirm the release language is signable as a one-page agreement and make any minimal redlines needed.
2) Add a 30-day notice window for takedowns/updates to be safe.
3) If acceptable, please sign and return the PDF to me so I can upload it to Orbit legal's portal.

If Orbit legal comes back with edits, please let me know and I'll route them directly to you.

Thanks,
Tessa

I reviewed the draft release and made two small modifications:
1) Replaced the blanket "public announcement" phrase with a scoped clause: "use in marketing materials (website, social media, and sales collateral)".
2) Added a 30-day notice period for takedown or material changes.

I signed and attached a PDF for Orbit to review (release_signed_orbit.pdf). If Orbit legal requests further edits, send them to me directly and I will prioritize.

30Laura Bennett
Corporate Counsel | Redwood Inference

Hi Tessa / Nina,

Thanks for the updated one-pager. We confirm the edits made by Redwood counsel are acceptable. Orbit approves:The clip may be published on Redwood's website and social channels using the monochrome/stylized logo. We request that any numeric metrics be presented as percentages or qualitative statements; please ensure the uploaded final video has the numbers redacted.

Attached is the signed release (release_signed_orbit.pdf). Please publish during the week of Dec 6 and share final URLs when live so we can amplify.

Regards,
